source_comparison: axiom schemas -> sheet lines 11-13 (A1-A3) and 15-17 (forall1, forall2 with x not free in the antecedent, exists1)

generalization rule -> sheet line 19 (Gen, x free in no premise on which the derivation of the premise line depends), with the dependency sets fixed by def:p02-hilbert-fol-dependencies (sheet 21-22; supplement 54-83)

deduction theorem with its free-variable side condition -> sheet lines 20-31 (statement, condition carried by derivability, links to thm:p02-hilbert-fol-deduction, annex:p2.fol.calc.5, annex:p02-w02-p02-025-discharge)

components.basis: The registered sheet displays A1-A3, MP, forall1, forall2 (x not free in the antecedent), exists1, existential elimination and Gen; Gen's side condition (line 19) forbids x free in any premise on which the premise line depends, and lines 21-22 fix the finite dependency sets in the body definition (clause 4 at supplement 68-70). The sheet is rendered on the current route by showcalculus{hilbert-fol} at classical-and-constructive-calculi.tex:176 (p14.tex:7, main.tex:48), with the three distinct variable checks restated at 168-174.

Sheet lines 23-25 state Gamma u {phi} |- psi iff Gamma |- phi -> psi; lines 25-28 state the free-variable condition (Gen and existential elimination apply to a line whose support contains phi only when the rule's variable is not free in phi); lines 28-31 link the theorem, its annex proof and the case-by-case derivations and exclude unrestricted generalization. The registry file's text after the rules is typeset with the sheet because showcalculus inputs the whole file (handbook.sty 1813-1827).
